l.i: 7 Grandior Abrahamo patre Melchisedech fuit olim, Et noua lex veteri commodiora dedit.
8 Inspicit exemplar Moises lex umbra futuri est, Lex noua promissa est, ergo vetusta perit.
9 Legales ritus cum Christi sanguine confert, Ostendens priscis villiora nova.
10 Magna facit Christus, quae lex praestare negabat, Vitro[?] peccantes horrida poena manet.
11 Narrat multa patrum stratagemata clara piorum, Quae sunt per firmam cuncta patrata fidem.
12 Omnino prodest correptio, nemo recedat. Mitia pro duris omnia facta docet.
13 Praepositis pare, ne te noua dogmata fallant. Connubij laudes, hospitibusque data.
Gustum, Melchisedech, Fixit, Velum, legis Vmbra
Quid sit sancta Fides, dominus Castigat, Anari.

main_text.l: Condita per Filium omnia: v. 2. Subiecit mundum futurum non angelis: v. 5. Moses fidus fuit in tota domo v. 5. Penetrans gladius est Dei verbum: v. 12. Miserari potest vicem ignorantium: v. 2.
Gustum qui habent doni coelestis: v. 4. Melchisedech rex Salem: v. 1. Fixit Dominus tabernaculum: v. 2. Velum post secundum erat tabernaculum: v. 3. legis Vmbra futurorum bonorum: v. 1.
Quid sit sancta Fides docet ex Patrum exemplis. Dominus Castigat cum quem diligit: v. 6. Anari ne sitis: v. 5.

page.notes: Page 137 of "Ad Hebraeos", with a commentary section on Hebrews 7 and 8. Verse 10 "Vitro" is probably "Viro"; it is marked [?]. The final line breaks off at "Epi-" at the edge of the text block and may continue beyond the scan. The left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is excluded. The numerals of the series and the italic keywords are copied as printed.
